title: Creator Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client-facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network — ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance‑driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client‑facing point of contact — presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end‑to‑end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom's creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross‑platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance‑oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator‑first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Based in Rio de Janeiro under a hybrid work model, this position will serve as a central coordination hub across multidisciplinary teams including geoscientists, data management professionals, software specialists, and client stakeholders, to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of Upstream projects using AspenTech’s Subsurface Science & Engineering software suites.
This is a high-impact opportunity to directly support one of Aspen Technology’s largest and most strategic customers in Latin America while contributing to Aspen Technology’s continued growth and success in the region.

Your Impact

  • Provide loyalty-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point between geoscientists, data management teams, software specialists, and customer stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery aligned with defined scope, schedule, quality, and contractual commitments.
  • Track and manage project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies, proactively escalating issues and driving resolution within Aspen Technology.
  • Facilitate and support project governance activities, including planning sessions, technical workshops, and regular status meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, identifying and communicating potential risks or gaps to management in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and deliver activity reports, project updates, and status communications to customers and internal management as required.
  • Provide timely and accurate KPI reporting for operations, financial, and corporate requirements.
  • Collaborate with other Aspen Technology functions to maintain and develop business opportunities.
  • Develop strong relationships with Customer, building an understanding of their business needs and operational challenges.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of project coordination practices, delivery workflows, and customer engagement models.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Data Science or Geosciences.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in IT, engineering, data science or geoscience related disciplines. University experience may count.
  • Experience managing Upstream Data
  • Experience coordinating Upstream Projects across multidisciplinary technical teams, including geoscientists, data management professionals and software specialists.
  • Familiarity with methodologies, tools, and best practices for tracking milestones, risks, and deliverables.
  • Experience creating dashboard and reporting metrics to track project performance and operational KPIs.
  • Familiarity with data and workflows to support quantitative seismic inversion projects.
  • Previous experience working on-site with customers is a plus.
  • Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
  • Ability to proactively take the leads in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.

description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. When you join us, you will have:

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

You’ll help consulting teams with research requirements on client projects on all oil & gas related matters.

You will then gather the necessary raw information using a broad spectrum of sources and will organize, analyze, and synthesize the findings into targeted, McKinsey‑formatted end products. These end products may be in the form of single exhibits, written summaries, basic fact packs, and spreadsheets.

Additionally, you are encouraged to build a solid knowledge base, developing an appropriately broad understanding of the relevant structure, players, and trends in your topic area(s) and deepening your expertise over time.
